text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Daiwa Scarlet! The
unquestioned
champion of her
generation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! I did it! I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I told you I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ughhh! Damn!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, fine! You win this time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But! I am the best! And I'll prove it next time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you can try.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I'll still be number one! And the time after that, too! I'll never lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka sure
are
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? No matter who wins, I can
never
wait for the rematch!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How frustrating. I fell just a little too
short.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm determined to do even better in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who chose to run sprints. I
don't
regret that decision.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? Vodka and Scarlet
are both
really great runners.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The thought of a race where those two
clash is
enough to get anyone excited.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That means I'll have to work harder than
ever and
dig even deeper if I still want
to leave my mark on
the path I've
chosen...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Starting with the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
choice_data_list: Yeah...! We're definitely going to win.
Yeah...! We're definitely going to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Aston Machan starts walking
in the
opposite direction of the hotel we
booked, so I
rush out to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's Kyoto in the fall. I have to get some
pictures
with the foliage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to come?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan and I enjoy a
stroll around
the city, taking in the
vibrant red and orange
leaves.
